promotionScope: Frozen active_context candidate only; eligible for the existing reviewed application/install route. This report does not certify installation or mark the product tasks complete.

deterministicComparison.meaning: Metadata inclusion and preservation; not model answer correctness by itself.

usage.historicalTrials: Prior failed-trial usage remains recorded separately; this does not erase or reset it.

independence.developmentScorerVisibility: Explicitly allowed by typed follow-up; final evaluator and holdout excluded from programming workspace.

evaluatorCorrection.description: Removed a historical development-only import allowlist accidentally copied into the new final adapter. The harmless math import did not violate a registered hardCondition. The preliminary static result is preserved privately; candidate, fixed criteria and holdout stayed unchanged.

limits: Four selected synthetic task-status questions, three samples per question and variant. Sampling and provider load can change timings; no confidence interval or broad conversational speed claim is supported.
Alternating variant order reduces order effects but does not eliminate network, caching or provider variance.
Reported answer times measure provider/model response latency inside the driver and exclude Docker/interpreter startup; they do not measure end-to-end task completion or household interaction.
One candidate reply supplied the correct status but additionally described a conditional lookup for further result detail; complete removal of follow-up lookups is not claimed.
Input tokens increased slightly. Promotion follows the newly-answerable-task branch, not the 20 percent token-reduction branch.
Own-initiative and T2 preservation are established by source comparison; installed combined behavior still requires the existing application verification.
This is one bounded task-context improvement, not recursive self-improvement, general AIDE² superiority, family acceptance, or completion of the full L3 outcome.
The legacy component-size limit is an application constraint outside this fixed evaluation; it was not used to change the candidate or scoring.
